title: Bibu's glowing ores
description: Never miss a diamond again with these glowing emissive ores.
body:
💎Bibu's Glowing Ores:
-

**Summary:** Make your ores shine in the dark! Experience a more immersive mining journey with beautiful emissive textures. **_(OptiFine Required)_**

![Glowing ores !](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d394d6c8f64cc2e5d4834ef93a9ae2df53a39110.png)

---
🔦 Why Bibu's Glowing Ores?
-
Tired of missing precious diamonds in the depths of dark caves? **Bibu's Glowing Ores** is designed to solve this issue! By adding a special emissive layer to all ore textures, this pack makes them visible even in total darkness.

Whether you are exploring massive caverns or mining at diamond level, you will never miss a resource again! It keeps the Vanilla Style you love while adding a magical glow.

---
Key Features:
-
**💎 Emissive Textures:** Only the ore minerals glow, leaving the surrounding stone perfectly dark.

**🎨 Vanilla Style:** Respects the original Minecraft designs—no strange textures, just better visibility.

**🚀 Lightweight:** Zero performance impact. Your FPS will stay high while your ores stay bright!

---
⚙️ Technical Requirements
-
**⚠️ IMPORTANT:**
For the glowing effect to work, you must use OptiFine. Once installed, make sure to enable the feature in your settings: Options > Video Settings > Quality > Emissive Textures: ON.
